summary: This directory manages error handling and diagnostic context for the TSDoc update process. It provides structured mechanisms for reporting issues encountered at specific stages of the update lifecycle, ensuring that developers receive clear information when the process fails.
responsibilities: Define error types for update operations
Track contextual information during failure events
Categorize errors by update process phase
relationships: UpdateError incorporates UpdateErrorContext to provide detailed debugging information.
The UpdatePhase concept categorizes exactly where an UpdateError occurred within the process flow.
designDecisions: Use of specialized error classes for domain-specific fault reporting
Centralized definition of process phases to ensure consistent error classification
